G.Venkatesan vs The Secretary To Government on 16 April, 
2024 
Author: D.Bharatha Chakravarthy
Bench: D.Bharatha Chakravarthy
 W.P.N
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras
 Dated: 16.04.2024
 Coram :
 The Hon'Ble Mr.Justice D.Bharatha Chakravarthy
 W.P.No.9346 of 2024
 G.Venkatesan .. 
 Vs.
 1. The Secretary To Government
 Health And Family Welfare Department
 Secretariat, Chennai 600009.
 2. The Commissioner
 Food Safety And Drug Administrative Department
 Anna Salai, Chennai 600006.
 3. The Designated Officer
 Food Safety And Drug Administrative Department
 2Nd Floor, Collector Office Campus
 Thiruvallur District 602001. ..  Res  Prayer: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of Ind  a Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondents to consider the  representation of the petitioner dated 29.01.2024 and consequently   the respondents to pay additional charge allowance for working as a  charge food safety officer to Thiruverkadu Municipality from 02.11.

G.Venkatesan vs The Secretary To Government on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73529132/ 
1  27.09.2023 and to Thirutani Municipality from 06.11.2023 to 08.12.2  and to Pallipattu Block and R.K.Pet Block from 08.12.2023 to till d  For the Petitioner : Mr.U.Jugal Kumar  For the Respondents : Mr.M.Bindhran  Additional Government   ORDER This Writ Petition is filed to consider the representation of the petitioner and consequently to direct the respondents to pay the additional charge allowance for the petitioner, who is working as an additional charge Food Safety Officer. 
2. When the matter came up for hearing, the learned Additional Government Pleader appearing on behalf of the respondents would place the proceedings of the Commissioner of Food Safety and Drug Administration dated 03.04.2024. As per the said proceedings, it is stated that the Food Safety Officers mentioned in the enclosure to the said proceedings were already sanctioned with an additional charge allowance at the rate https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis mentioned therein. For various periods, all the entitled officers have been sanctioned and the name of the petitioner finds place in the annexure. 
3. In view thereof, the grievance of the petitioner has been redressed by the said proceedings dated 03.04.2024. Recording the same, no further order needs to be passed in the Writ Petition. 
Accordingly, this Writ Petition stands disposed of. No costs. 
 
 Index : Yes  Neutral Citation : No  Speaking order : Yes  Jer  To  1. THE SECRETARY TO GOVERNMENT HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE DEPARTMENT SECRETARIAT, CHENNAI 600009.
2. THE COMMISSIONER FOOD SAFETY AND DRUG ADMINISTRATIVE DEPARTMENT ANNA SALAI, CHENNAI 600006.
3. THE DESIGNATED OFFICER FOOD SAFETY AND DRUG ADMINISTRATIVE DEPARTMENT 2ND FLOOR, COLLECTOR OFFICE CAMPUS THIRUVALLUR DISTRICT 602001.
